shortDescription: Creates information for Scheduled Downtime object.

options.name: apply
options.description: Whether this Notification should be an applied Notification.

options.name: apply_target
options.description: Whether this Notification should be a host or a service Notification.

options.name: assign
options.description: List of conditions for where to apply this Notification.

options.name: child_options
options.description: Schedule child downtimes. DowntimeNoChildren does not do anything, DowntimeTriggeredChildren schedules child downtimes triggered by this downtime, DowntimeNonTriggeredChildren schedules non-triggered downtimes.

options.name: display_name
options.description: The display name for this Scheduled Downtime.

options.name: duration
options.description: How long the downtime lasts. Only has an effect for flexible (non-fixed) downtimes.

options.name: file
options.description: Path to the file in which the object will be defined.

options.name: fixed
options.description: Whether this is a fixed downtime.

options.name: host_name
options.description: The name of the host this scheduled downtime belongs to.

options.name: ignore
options.description: List of conditions for where to ignore this Notification.

options.name: imports
options.description: List of imports for the Notification.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Scheduled Downtime object.

options.name: ranges
options.description: A dictionary containing information which days and durations apply to this timeperiod.

options.name: service_name
options.description: The short name of the service this scheduled downtime belongs to. If omitted, this downtime object is treated as host downtime.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the Scheduled Downtime object.

options.name: template
options.description: Whether the Notification is a template.
